'''Thoha'lynda''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]]. He created [[Leather/Legends|leather]] goods from the hides of [[Rycrit/Legends|rycrits]] and sold them in the bazaar in [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]].
